search_window.basis: Prior verified Care Line Watch heartbeat completed at 15:43:48 PDT. These are newly identified recall candidates missed by previous checks; source reports and underlying events predate this precise hourly window, and are not represented as events first occurring within it.

findings.title: Vista Medical Center East loses contracted anesthesia coverage across critical departments
findings.exact_supporting_passage: all anesthesia services provided by their group would be suspended at 12 p.m. Thursday
findings.access_consequences: Contracted anesthesia providers suspended new anesthesia services at noon CDT October 22 across the operating room, emergency department, cardiac catheterization lab, endoscopy and ICU; urgent and emergency anesthesia covered by that group was affected. The hospital had no anesthesia services as of October 23 according to a report source. The state is evaluating Level II trauma designation. State says no formal ambulance bypass; a separate source reports trauma patients were not accepted. Hospital replacement coverage, if any, remains unverified.
findings.affected_population: Hospital patients needing scheduled or emergency anesthesia, surgical or procedural care, and potentially trauma care in Waukegan and surrounding Lake County; patient count unknown.

findings.title: Rehabilitation Hospital of Rhode Island temporarily evacuated and closed after unexplained illness
findings.exact_supporting_passage: A rehabilitation hospital in southern New England was evacuated and closed overnight after patients and staff suddenly fell ill.
findings.access_consequences: Facility evacuated and closed on the evening of October 22 after nine patients and staff became ill. Symptomatic individuals were transported by ambulance to other hospitals. Cause remains unidentified; reopening status, duration, and whether all inpatient rehabilitation services have resumed are unverified.
findings.affected_population: Rehabilitation Hospital of Rhode Island inpatients and employees, including nine reported sick patients/staff collectively; total facility census unknown.

findings.title: Carle Normal on College outpatient clinic closed until further notice after vehicle crash
findings.exact_supporting_passage: A Carle outpatient facility in Normal is closed until further notice after a truck drove into the building.
findings.access_consequences: Carle Normal on College at 1437 E. College Avenue closed until further notice after October 23 vehicle collision damaged building. Building not cleared for public occupancy pending structural and safety repairs. Patients with upcoming physician appointments will be contacted for rescheduling. Whether this location provides primary care specifically has not been independently confirmed.
findings.affected_population: Patients with scheduled appointments at Carle Normal on College; number and specific clinical specialties unknown.
